post.description: Accepts a consent-aware server-side conversion event. Supply either event_id in the JSON body or Idempotency-Key in the request headers to make retries idempotent.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional idempotency key. When event_id is omitted, PlainRouter uses this value as event_id. If both are supplied, they must match.

parent_event_id.description: Optional parent event id; maximum 128 characters.

event_time.description: Unix timestamp or ISO-8601 date-time. Defaults to receipt time.

action_source.description: Optional action source; defaults to website and is limited to 50 characters.

consent_basis.description: Legal basis for processing. Legitimate-interest revenue lifecycle events are rejected; use an authenticated server adapter.

consent.description: Consent state supplied with the event.

consent_mode.description: Consent Mode v2 signal values supplied with the event.

tcf.description: TCF v2 data containing string and optional captured_at.

user_data.description: Identity fields accepted by the tracker.

value_data.description: Optional commerce data. Contents accepts at most 50 items and 16 KB serialized.
